chunks: Verily there is a sign in this, yet many of them do not believe.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that there is a sign in the event but most people did not believe?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a rhetorical pivot, reminding the Prophet Muhammad that the rejection of divine signs by the majority is a recurring historical pattern, thereby validating his patience. Shia scholarship often interprets this 'ayah' not merely as a miracle but as a logical proof (hujjah) that distinguishes between intellectual recognition and spiritual conviction, emphasizing that faith requires active acceptance of the evidence presented.
